property_summary: After any call to transferOwnership, the current owner must remain unchanged because the onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender to be the owner, and only the owner can succeed; the bug reverses the check to msg.sender != owner, letting a non-owner change the owner.
change_summary: Replace `require(msg.sender == owner);` with `require(msg.sender != owner);` so only non-owner can call, reversing access control.
